statement: Let Q be a connected finite aspherical CW complex, put G = π1(Q), and let w: G ↠ Z be an epimorphism. For every positive integer d, write Gd = w−1 (dZ) and Qd −→ Q for the associated connected cyclic cover. Fix an integer n ≥ 1. Suppose that Q2 has a closed topological n-manifold model M, but that Qd has no such model for every sufficiently large odd integer d. 3 Choose γ ∈ G with w(γ) = 1, and use the model equivalence to identify π1(M) with G2. The outer automorphism of G2 represented by α(g) = γgγ−1 is induced by a self-homotopy equivalence of M. No homeomorphism of M induces this outer automorphism. In particular, that self-homotopy equivalence is not homotopic to a homeomorphism.
